units.source_text: 据驹子说，迎接滑雪客人的筹备会将在这家客栈里举行，她是应召在会后举行的宴会上陪客的。

en.t: According to Komako, a planning meeting to welcome the ski guests was to be held at this inn, and she had been called to entertain guests at the banquet afterward.

units.source_text: 她把脚伸进了被炉，冷不防地来回抚摸岛村的脸颊。

en.t: She slipped her feet into the kotatsu and, without warning, stroked Shimamura's cheeks back and forth.
